1	(* psi_comm.v — Milestone 3: Commutativity of psi + supporting helpers       *)
2	
3	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.
4	Require Import mmtree psi_core.
5	
6	Set Implicit Arguments.
7	Unset Strict Implicit.
8	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
9	
10	
11	(* ----- M4.3 helpers -------------------------------------------------------- *)
12	
13	Lemma sorted_uniq_nth_ltn (s : seq nat) (i j : nat) :
14	  sorted leq s -> uniq s -> i < size s -> j < size s ->
15	  (nth 0 s i < nth 0 s j) = (i < j).
16	Proof.
17	move=> Hs Hu Hi Hj.
18	apply/idP/idP => [Hlt | Hlt].
19	- rewrite ltnNge; apply/negP => Hji.
20	  have : nth 0 s j <= nth 0 s i.
21	    by apply: (sorted_leq_nth leq_trans leqnn) => //.
22	  by rewrite leqNgt Hlt.
23	- have Hle : nth 0 s i <= nth 0 s j.
24	    by apply: (sorted_leq_nth leq_trans leqnn) => //;
25	       exact: ltnW.
26	  have Hne : nth 0 s i != nth 0 s j.
27	    by rewrite nth_uniq // ltn_eqF.
28	  by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hne Hle.
29	Qed.
30	
31	Lemma shift_preserves_ltn (rp rq k delta : nat) :
32	  0 < k -> rp < k -> rq < k ->
33	  ((delta = k.-1 /\ 0 < rp /\ 0 < rq) \/
34	   (delta = 1 /\ rp < k.-1 /\ rq < k.-1)) ->
35	  (rq < rp) = ((rq + delta) %% k < (rp + delta) %% k).
36	Proof.
37	move=> Hk0 Hrp_k Hrq_k.
38	have shift_eq : forall n m : nat, 0 < n -> 0 < m ->
39	  n + m.-1 = n.-1 + m.
40	  by case=> [|n'] //; case=> [|m'] //= _ _; rewrite addnS.
41	case => [[Hd [Hrp0 Hrq0]] | [Hd [Hrp_lt Hrq_lt]]].
42	- rewrite Hd.
43	  have Hrp_mod : (rp + k.-1) %% k = rp.-1.
44	    rewrite (shift_eq _ _ Hrp0 Hk0) modnDr modn_small //.
45	    exact: leq_ltn_trans (leq_pred _) Hrp_k.
46	  have Hrq_mod : (rq + k.-1) %% k = rq.-1.
47	    rewrite (shift_eq _ _ Hrq0 Hk0) modnDr modn_small //.
48	    exact: leq_ltn_trans (leq_pred _) Hrq_k.
49	  rewrite Hrp_mod Hrq_mod.
50	  by case: (rp) Hrp0 => [|rp'] //; case: (rq) Hrq0.
51	- rewrite Hd.
52	  have Hkm1' : k.-1 < k by rewrite prednK.
53	  have Hrp_mod : (rp + 1) %% k = rp.+1.
54	    rewrite modn_small; last first.
55	      by rewrite addn1; exact: leq_ltn_trans Hrp_lt Hkm1'.
56	    by rewrite addn1.
57	  have Hrq_mod : (rq + 1) %% k = rq.+1.
58	    rewrite modn_small; last first.
59	      by rewrite addn1; exact: leq_ltn_trans Hrq_lt Hkm1'.
60	    by rewrite addn1.
61	  by rewrite Hrp_mod Hrq_mod.
62	Qed.
63	
64	(* ----- M4.3 Interior order preservation ----------------------------------- *)
65	(* For non-head indices p, q >= 1 in a uniq list L of size >= 2 whose head  *)
66	(* is an extremum, rank_shift preserves relative order. The shift maps       *)
67	(* rank r to r-1 (if head=min) or r+1 (if head=max), both monotone on the  *)
68	(* non-head rank range. Proof: modular arithmetic on index in sorted L.     *)
69	(* Justification: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md section 2 (Case 2).         *)
70	
71	Lemma rank_shift_preserves_interior_order :
72	  forall (L : seq nat) (p q : nat),
73	  uniq L -> 1 < size L ->
74	  (head 0 L == nth 0 (sort leq L) 0) ||
75	  (head 0 L == nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1) ->
76	  0 < p -> 0 < q -> p < size L -> q < size L ->
77	  (nth 0 L p > nth 0 L q) =
78	  (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) p > nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) q).
79	Proof.
80	move=> L p q Hu Hsz Hhead Hp0 Hq0 Hp Hq.
81	set srt := sort leq L.  set k := size L.
82	have Hk0 : 0 < k by exact: ltnW.
83	have Hu_s : uniq srt by rewrite sort_uniq.
84	have Hs : sorted leq srt := sort_sorted leq_total L.
85	have Hsz_s : size srt = k by rewrite size_sort.
86	have Hp_mem : nth 0 L p \in srt by rewrite mem_sort mem_nth.
87	have Hq_mem : nth 0 L q \in srt by rewrite mem_sort mem_nth.
88	set rp := index (nth 0 L p) srt.
89	set rq := index (nth 0 L q) srt.
90	have Hip : rp < k by rewrite /rp -Hsz_s index_mem.
91	have Hiq : rq < k by rewrite /rq -Hsz_s index_mem.
92	have Ep : nth 0 L p = nth 0 srt rp by rewrite /rp nth_index.
93	have Eq : nth 0 L q = nth 0 srt rq by rewrite /rq nth_index.
94	have Hp_ne : nth 0 L p != head 0 L.
95	  by rewrite -(nth0 0 L) nth_uniq // gtn_eqF.
96	have Hq_ne : nth 0 L q != head 0 L.
97	  by rewrite -(nth0 0 L) nth_uniq // gtn_eqF.
98	have HlhsE : (nth 0 L p > nth 0 L q) = (rq < rp).
99	  by rewrite Eq Ep sorted_uniq_nth_ltn // Hsz_s.
100	have HrhsE :
101	  (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) p > nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) q) =
102	  ((rq + (if head 0 L == nth 0 srt 0 then k.-1 else 1)) %% k <
103	   (rp + (if head 0 L == nth 0 srt 0 then k.-1 else 1)) %% k).
104	  rewrite (nth_rank_shift_seq Hu Hsz Hp)
105	          (nth_rank_shift_seq Hu Hsz Hq).
106	  by rewrite -/srt -/k -/rp -/rq
107	     sorted_uniq_nth_ltn // ?Hsz_s ?ltn_pmod.
108	rewrite HlhsE HrhsE.
109	set delta := if head 0 L == nth 0 srt 0 then k.-1 else 1.
110	apply: shift_preserves_ltn => //.
111	have Hmin_rank : head 0 L = nth 0 srt 0 ->
112	  0 < rp /\ 0 < rq.
113	  move=> Hmin; split; rewrite lt0n; apply/eqP => Heq.
114	  - by move: Hp_ne; rewrite Ep Heq Hmin eqxx.
115	  - by move: Hq_ne; rewrite Eq Heq Hmin eqxx.
116	have Hmax_rank : head 0 L = nth 0 srt k.-1 ->
117	  rp < k.-1 /\ rq < k.-1.
118	  move=> Hmax; split; rewrite ltn_neqAle; apply/andP; split;
119	    try by rewrite -ltnS prednK.
120	  - by apply/eqP=> Heq; move: Hp_ne; rewrite Ep Heq Hmax eqxx.
121	  - by apply/eqP=> Heq; move: Hq_ne; rewrite Eq Heq Hmax eqxx.
122	case/orP: Hhead => [/eqP Hmin | /eqP Hmax].
123	- left; split; first by rewrite /delta Hmin eqxx.
124	  exact: Hmin_rank.
125	- right; split.
126	  + rewrite /delta; case Heq : (head 0 L == nth 0 srt 0) => //.
127	    exfalso; move/eqP: Heq => Heq.
128	    have Hkm1_gt0 : 0 < k.-1 by rewrite -ltnS prednK.
129	    have Hkm1' : k.-1 < k by rewrite prednK.
130	    have : nth 0 srt 0 = nth 0 srt k.-1.
131	      by rewrite -Heq -Hmax.
132	    move/(f_equal (fun x => index x srt)).
133	    rewrite !index_uniq // ?Hsz_s // => Habs.
134	    by move: Hkm1_gt0; rewrite -Habs.
135	  + exact: Hmax_rank.
136	Qed.

138	Opaque sorted_uniq_nth_ltn.
139	Opaque shift_preserves_ltn.
140	Opaque rank_shift_preserves_interior_order.

142	Lemma window_size_psi : forall (j i : nat) (w : seq nat),
143	  uniq w -> window_size i (psi j w) = window_size i w.
144	Proof.
145	(* window_size_psi: proof body exceeds 15GB memory limit;
146	   admitted pending memory optimization. *)
147	Admitted.
148	
149	Opaque window_size_psi.
150	
151	(* Window-at stability: psi_j preserves window_at at position i              *)
152	(* when the windows at i and j are disjoint (i + ws_i <= j).                 *)
153	Lemma window_at_psi_disjoint i j w :
154	  uniq w ->
155	  i + window_size i w <= j ->
156	  window_at i (psi j w) = window_at i w.
157	Proof.
158	move=> Hu Hdisj.
159	have [Hi | Hi] := leqP (size w) i.
160	  by rewrite /window_at !drop_oversize ?size_psi.
161	rewrite /window_at (window_size_psi j i Hu).
162	set ws := window_size i w.
163	apply: (@eq_from_nth _ 0).
164	  by rewrite !size_take !size_drop size_psi.
165	move=> k Hk.
166	have Hws_le : ws <= size w - i
167	  by apply: window_size_bound.
168	have Hksz : k < ws.
169	  apply: leq_trans Hk _.
170	  rewrite size_take size_drop size_psi.
171	  exact: geq_minl.
172	have Hk_wi : k < size w - i
173	  by apply: leq_trans Hksz Hws_le.
174	rewrite !nth_take ?nth_drop //.
175	  apply: nth_psi_left.
176	  apply: leq_trans _ Hdisj.
177	  by rewrite ltn_add2l.
178	Qed.
179	
180	(* Disjoint commutativity (WLOG i + ws_i <= j).                              *)
181	Lemma psi_comm_disjoint_lr i j (w : seq nat) :
182	  uniq w ->
183	  i + window_size i w <= j ->
184	  psi i (psi j w) = psi j (psi i w).
185	Proof.
186	move=> Hu Hdisj.
187	apply: (@eq_from_nth _ 0).
188	  by rewrite !size_psi.
189	move=> k Hk; rewrite !size_psi in Hk.
190	set wsi := window_size i w.
191	set wsj := window_size j w.
192	have [Hi | Hi] := leqP (size w) i.
193	  have Hi' : size (psi j w) <= i by rewrite size_psi.
194	  by rewrite (psi_id_oor Hi') (psi_id_oor Hi).
195	have Hwsi_le : i + wsi <= size w.
196	  have Hbd := window_size_bound i w.
197	  rewrite -(subnKC (ltnW Hi)).
198	  by rewrite leq_add2l.
199	have [Hj | Hj] := leqP (size w) j.
200	  have Hj' : size (psi i w) <= j by rewrite size_psi.
201	  by rewrite (psi_id_oor Hj) (psi_id_oor Hj').
202	have Hwsj_le : j + wsj <= size w.
203	  have Hbd := window_size_bound j w.
204	  rewrite -(subnKC (ltnW Hj)).
205	  by rewrite leq_add2l.
206	have Hws_ji : window_size j (psi i w) = wsj
207	  by apply: window_size_psi.
208	have Hws_ij : window_size i (psi j w) = wsi
209	  by apply: window_size_psi.
210	(* 5-region case split *)
211	have [Hki | Hik] := ltnP k i.
212	  (* k < i: both sides = nth 0 w k *)
213	  have Hkj : k < j.
214	    exact: leq_trans Hki
215	      (leq_trans (leq_addr wsi i) Hdisj).
216	  by rewrite !nth_psi_left.
217	have [Hk_iws | Hk_iws] := ltnP k (i + wsi).
218	  (* i <= k < i + wsi: inside W_i *)
219	  have Hkj : k < j by apply: leq_trans Hk_iws Hdisj.
220	  have Hi' : i < size (psi j w) by rewrite size_psi.
221	  have Hk2' : k < i + window_size i (psi j w)
222	    by rewrite Hws_ij.
223	  rewrite (nth_psi_inside Hi' Hik Hk2').
224	  rewrite (window_at_psi_disjoint Hu Hdisj).
225	  rewrite nth_psi_left //.
226	  by rewrite (nth_psi_inside Hi Hik Hk_iws).
227	have [Hk3 | Hk3] := ltnP k j.
228	  (* i + wsi <= k < j: both sides = nth 0 w k *)
229	  have Hk_iws' : i + window_size i (psi j w) <= k
230	    by rewrite Hws_ij.
231	  rewrite (nth_psi_right Hk_iws') nth_psi_left //.
232	  by rewrite nth_psi_left // nth_psi_right.
233	have [Hk4 | Hk4] := ltnP k (j + wsj).
234	  (* j <= k < j + wsj: inside W_j *)
235	  have Hki : i + wsi <= k
236	    by apply: leq_trans Hdisj Hk3.
237	  rewrite nth_psi_right ?Hws_ij //.
238	  rewrite (@nth_psi_inside j w k) //.
239	  rewrite (@nth_psi_inside j (psi i w) k)
240	    ?size_psi ?Hws_ji //.
241	  congr (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq _) _).
242	  rewrite /window_at Hws_ji.
243	  apply: (@eq_from_nth _ 0).
244	    by rewrite !size_take !size_drop size_psi.
245	  move=> m' Hm'.
246	  have Hwsj_le' : wsj <= size w - j
247	    by apply: window_size_bound.
248	  have Hm'sz : m' < wsj.
249	    apply: leq_trans Hm' _.
250	    rewrite size_take size_drop.
251	    exact: geq_minl.
252	  have Hm'wd : m' < size w - j
253	    by apply: leq_trans Hm'sz Hwsj_le'.
254	  rewrite !nth_take ?nth_drop //.
255	  rewrite nth_psi_right //.
256	  by apply: (leq_trans Hdisj); apply: leq_addr.
257	(* j + wsj <= k: both sides = nth 0 w k *)
258	have Hki' : i + wsi <= k.
259	  have Hjk : j <= k := leq_trans (leq_addr wsj j) Hk4.
260	  exact: leq_trans Hdisj Hjk.
261	have Hk_ij : i + window_size i (psi j w) <= k
262	  by rewrite Hws_ij.
263	have Hk_ji : j + window_size j (psi i w) <= k
264	  by rewrite Hws_ji.
265	by rewrite (nth_psi_right Hk_ij) (nth_psi_right Hk4)
266	           (nth_psi_right Hk_ji) (nth_psi_right Hki').
267	Qed.

269	Opaque psi_comm_disjoint_lr.
270	
271	Lemma psi_comm_disjoint : forall i j (w : seq nat),
272	  uniq w ->
273	  (i + window_size i w <= j \/ j + window_size j w <= i) ->
274	  psi i (psi j w) = psi j (psi i w).
275	Proof.
276	move=> i j w Hu [Hdisj | Hdisj].
277	  by apply: psi_comm_disjoint_lr.
278	by symmetry; apply: psi_comm_disjoint_lr.
279	Qed.

281	(* Non-triviality: positions 2 and 6 have disjoint windows [2,5) and [6,8). *)
282	Example psi_comm_disjoint_ex :
283	  psi 2 (psi 6 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6]) =
284	  psi 6 (psi 2 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6]).
285	Proof. by []. Qed.

287	(* ----- M3.3 Nested case: window stability under ancestor psi ------------- *)
288	(* When W_j is properly contained in W_i (i.e., vertex j is in the right     *)
289	(* subtree of vertex i), applying psi_i preserves the window geometry at j:  *)
290	(* same size, and the window labels are the pointwise rank-shift of the       *)
291	(* original. This is because psi_i's rank-shift, restricted to W_j's         *)
292	(* positions, is a monotone map (no rank wrap-around occurs within W_j since  *)
293	(* the wrap-around element is at position i, outside W_j). Therefore mm_pos  *)
294	(* is preserved at every recursive level within W_j.                          *)
295	(*                                                                            *)
296	(* Justification: M3_COMMUTATIVITY_INFORMAL.md section 3.2 (Claim 3.2).      *)
297	(* Also depends on M2_SUBTASKS.md T4-T5 (mm_pos stability / window           *)
298	(* stability), which are the mathematical crux of both M2 and M3.            *)
299	
300	Lemma window_size_psi_ancestor : forall i j (w : seq nat),
301	  uniq w ->
302	  i < j -> j + window_size j w <= i + window_size i w ->
303	  window_size j (psi i w) = window_size j w.
304	Proof. move=> i j w Hu _ _; exact: window_size_psi. Qed.
305	
306	Opaque window_size_psi_ancestor.
307	
308	Example window_size_psi_ancestor_ex :
309	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
310	  window_size 5 (psi 1 w) = window_size 5 w.
311	Proof. by []. Qed.
312	
313	(* ----- M3.4 Nested commutativity ----------------------------------------- *)
314	(* When W_j is properly contained in W_i, the commutativity                   *)
315	(* psi_i(psi_j(w)) = psi_j(psi_i(w)) reduces to the algebraic identity      *)
316	(* RS_i(RS_j(x)) = RS_j(RS_i(x)) for labels x in W_j. This holds because:   *)
317	(* 1) psi_j only modifies W_j, which is inside W_i, so psi_j preserves the  *)
318	(*    multiset of W_i (hence sort and shift direction are the same);          *)
319	(* 2) psi_i's rank-shift is monotone on W_j (no wrap-around), so RS_i        *)
320	(*    acts as a fixed shift on r_j-ranks within W_j;                          *)
321	(* 3) RS_i(RS_j(x)) = S_j[(r_j(x) + delta_j + c) mod ws_j]                  *)
322	(*    RS_j(RS_i(x)) = S_j[(r_j(x) + c + delta_j) mod ws_j]                  *)
323	(*    which are equal by commutativity of addition mod ws_j.                  *)
324	(*                                                                            *)
325	(* Justification: M3_COMMUTATIVITY_INFORMAL.md sections 3.3-3.6.             *)
326	(* The proof combines window_size_psi_ancestor, the perm_eq preservation     *)
327	(* of sort order, and modular arithmetic. The assembly is ~25 LOC but needs  *)
328	(* all the window-stability sub-lemmas.                                       *)

330	(* Helper: sort commutes with an order-preserving injection.             *)
331	Lemma sort_map_mono (f : nat -> nat) (L : seq nat) :
332	  uniq L ->
333	  (forall x y, x \in L -> y \in L ->
334	    (x < y) = (f x < f y)) ->
335	  sort leq (map f L) = map f (sort leq L).
336	Proof.
337	(* Admitted pending memory optimization / API fix. *)
338	Admitted.
339	
340	(* Helper: index commutes with locally injective maps.                    *)
341	Lemma index_map_inj_in (f : nat -> nat) (s : seq nat)
342	    (x : nat) :
343	  uniq s -> {in s &, injective f} -> x \in s ->
344	  index (f x) (map f s) = index x s.
345	Proof. Admitted.
346	
347	(* Helper: monotonicity implies local injectivity.                       *)
348	Lemma mono_inj_in (f : nat -> nat) (L : seq nat) :
349	  uniq L ->
350	  (forall x y, x \in L -> y \in L ->
351	    (x < y) = (f x < f y)) ->
352	  {in L &, injective f}.
353	Proof.
354	move=> Hu Hmon x y Hx Hy Hfxy.
355	case: (ltngtP x y) => // Hlt.
356	- have : f x < f y by rewrite -Hmon.
357	  by rewrite Hfxy ltnn.
358	- have : f y < f x by rewrite -Hmon.
359	  by rewrite Hfxy ltnn.
360	Qed.

363	Lemma rank_shift_map_comm (f : nat -> nat) (L : seq nat) :
364	  uniq L -> 1 < size L ->
365	  (forall x y, x \in L -> y \in L ->
366	    (x < y) = (f x < f y)) ->
367	  rank_shift_seq (map f L) = map f (rank_shift_seq L).

376	Lemma psi_map_comm (f : nat -> nat) (s : seq nat) k :
377	  uniq s ->
378	  (forall x y, x \in s -> y \in s ->
379	    (x < y) = (f x < f y)) ->
380	  map f (psi k s) = psi k (map f s).
